question: You suddenly have a completely free weekend. What sounds the most exciting?

choices.text: Taking a spontaneous road trip somewhere I've never been.
Staying home with snacks and watching something hilarious.
Having a cozy date night with someone I care about.
Solving a puzzle, playing a mystery game, or figuring out a brain teaser.
Watching a creepy movie alone with the lights off.

question: You're exploring a new place and discover a mysterious door. What do you do?

choices.text: Open it immediately. Who knows what's behind it?
Make a joke about how this is obviously how horror movies begin.
Wait for someone else to open it with me.
Look around for clues before touching anything.
Open it because I'm hoping something terrifying happens.

question: What kind of book ending do you enjoy most?

choices.text: A huge adventure that leaves me wanting to explore the world myself.
Something funny that leaves me smiling.
A satisfying romantic ending that makes me believe in love.
A shocking twist that makes me rethink everything I just read.
An unsettling ending that stays in my head long after I finish the book.

question: Your friends invite you to try something you've never done before. You...

choices.text: Say 'Absolutely!' before they even explain what it is.
Ask whether there will at least be snacks and entertainment.
Agree because spending time with people you love is what matters.
Ask a million questions before deciding.
Ask whether there's a chance something scary could happen.

question: Which fictional character would you most want to spend a day with?

choices.text: An adventurous explorer who is always looking for their next challenge.
The character who makes everyone laugh even when everything goes wrong.
The hopeless romantic who believes everyone has a soulmate.
The detective who always seems to notice what everyone else misses.
The character who somehow survives every terrifying situation.

question: You're reading a book and the main character makes a questionable decision. What's your reaction?

choices.text: Let's see where this adventure goes!
Oh no...this is going to be hilarious.
I hope this doesn't ruin their relationship!
Wait. Why did they do that? Something isn't right.
Yep. They're definitely about to get themselves killed.

question: Which vacation sounds the most appealing?

choices.text: Hiking through mountains or exploring a foreign country.
Visiting a fun city with comedy shows, food, and entertainment.
A romantic getaway somewhere beautiful and peaceful.
Visiting an old city filled with history, secrets, and unsolved stories.
Staying somewhere famous for being haunted.

question: Someone tells you, 'I have a secret, but I can't tell you yet.' What do you do?

choices.text: Fine...but I'm coming with you when you reveal it.
Make up increasingly ridiculous guesses until they tell you.
Patiently wait because I don't want to pressure them.
Start analyzing everything they've said to figure it out myself.
Wonder if the secret involves something supernatural.

question: What makes you keep reading a book late into the night?

choices.text: The characters are on an incredible adventure and I need to know what happens next.
The story is so funny that I keep laughing and turning the pages.
I need to know whether the characters will end up together.
There are unanswered questions and I need to solve the mystery.
The story is terrifying and I have to know what happens—even though I'm scared.
Teleportation — I'd travel everywhere.
Making anyone laugh instantly.
Knowing when someone is your perfect match.
Knowing when someone is lying.
Being able to communicate with ghosts.

question: You're at a party where you don't know anyone. What are you most likely to do?

choices.text: Find someone interesting and convince them to go on an adventure.
Find the funniest person there and start joking around.
Look for someone I connect with and have a meaningful conversation.
Observe everyone and try to figure out who knows whom.
Find the darkest room in the house and investigate it.

question: Which plot would immediately grab your attention?

choices.text: A group of explorers discovers an unknown world.
Two complete disasters accidentally become roommates.
Two people who can't stand each other slowly fall in love.
A detective discovers that everyone involved in a crime is hiding something.
A family moves into a house with a terrifying history.

question: What kind of challenge sounds the most fun?

choices.text: Something physically or mentally challenging that pushes me outside my comfort zone.
A ridiculous challenge where everyone ends up laughing.
Something that helps me connect more deeply with another person.
A complicated puzzle that requires me to figure out the answer.
Spending the night somewhere supposedly haunted.

question: Your friend says, 'I found something strange in the basement.' What is your first thought?

choices.text: Let's go see what it is!
If we die, I'm blaming you.
Are you okay? Do you want me to come with you?
What exactly did you find? Start from the beginning.
Please tell me it's a ghost.

question: Which statement sounds most like you?

choices.text: Life is too short not to try something new.
Everything is better when you can laugh about it.
The best stories are about connection and love.
There's always more to the story than what you see.
I want a story that keeps me up at night.
